summary_en: 6,000,000 shares (0.88% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via open-market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Upper limit price: ¥10.0 billion. Execution window: 17 August 2026 to 30 December 2026. Stated rationale: enhance capital efficiency and corporate value.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Shimizu Corporation's board of directors approved on 30 July 2026 the acquisition of up to 6,000,000 of its own shares (0.88% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The upper limit on the acquisition price is ¥10.0 billion. The execution period runs from 17 August 2026 to 30 December 2026. The company states the objective is to enhance capital efficiency and corporate value. As of 30 June 2026, Shimizu held 37,493,722 treasury shares against a total issued share count of 679,195,691 shares excluding treasury.
